localNeeds.name: Repair and object care
localNeeds.description: Residents have useful things wearing out and would rather understand, maintain, or restore them than replace everything.

localNeeds.name: Affordable food and warm pauses
localNeeds.description: Some residents need simple food, a short place to sit, or a modest shared pause without premium pricing.

localNeeds.name: Practical learning and source help
localNeeds.description: Residents have questions, skills they want to grow, and moments where patient guidance is more useful than another opaque service.

localNeeds.name: Creative and visual support
localNeeds.description: People have small ideas, rooms, events, stories, and projects that could use help becoming visible without becoming corporate products.

localNeeds.name: Reuse and low-cost useful goods
localNeeds.description: The town contains underused objects and residents with limited budgets. Careful reuse can connect the two without artificial rarity.

localNeeds.name: Small local connection
localNeeds.description: Residents sometimes need a reason to cross paths, ask for help, or discover a nearby person without being trapped in engagement mechanics.
